title: The tube, 2025
logline: The one firework's tube from the Fourth in the coffee can on the dock, and beside it a second can with a second tube: the 2020 one, kept, and this year's, hers. Two cans. The page counts.

panels.composition: Two coffee cans side by side on dock planks each holding a single spent firework tube, one faded and one fresh, the lawn chair behind.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, two coffee cans side by side on dock planks each holding a single spent cardboard firework tube, one faded and one fresh, an old lawn chair behind, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
